reports.title: UBIQUITI INC. REPORTS FIRST QUARTER FISCAL 2027 FINANCIAL RESULTS

desk.headline: Record revenue up 40% to $1.03bn and EPS $5.32, well above estimates; no guidance given
results: Revenue hit a record $1.03bn, up 40% from a year ago and 9.5% from the prior quarter, led by Enterprise Technology.
Gross margin rose to 47.3% on lower indirect costs, partly offset by higher component prices.
Operating costs stayed lean at $93.9m; operating income rose 50% to $391.5m.
GAAP net income rose 54% to $320.5m ($5.29 per share); non-GAAP EPS was $5.32.
Declared a $1.00 quarterly dividend, payable 23 Nov.

guidance.summary: Ubiquiti gives no financial guidance. It warned that component costs have risen since last quarter and may keep rising, with supply tight, which could pressure margins and limit sales.
